name: ibm-deck
description: IBM-branded presentation skills. `ibm-deck-htmltopptx` converts an existing HTML presentation into an editable .pptx re-typeset in the IBM Design Language: IBM Plex type, the Carbon color palette, the 2x grid, flat zero-radius shapes and a left-aligned editorial layout. Carries the design system as authoritative tokens so decks converted in different repos stay consistent.
